description: Read-only. Retrieve current free 60-minute online consultation slots for a date range in Europe/Warsaw. Provide from as a YYYY-MM-DD date and days from 1 to 14 (defaults to 14). Only free slots are returned; no calendar event details or other clients’ information are exposed. This tool cannot reserve a slot, create a booking, or initiate payment.

days.description: Number of consecutive calendar days to check, from 1 to 14. Defaults to 14 when omitted.

from.description: First date to check, inclusive, in YYYY-MM-DD format using the Europe/Warsaw time zone.

name: list_available_slots
title: List available online consultation slots
